services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Yakima Valley Museum offers guided school tours from Tuesday to Friday, 10:00 am - 4:00 pm, providing students with an engaging look at the history of the Yakima Valley. Tours are led by knowledgeable docents and last approximately one hour. First and second grade classes can enhance their visit with hands-on activities in the Children’s Underground.The tour season runs from September 20 to May 30. Admission is $5 per student, with a $25 minimum charge, while teachers and chaperones attend for free.
